name: Evafresh Multi-Surface Cleaner
shortDescription: A trigger-spray cleaner and degreaser for counters, tables and tiles.
description: Evafresh Multi-Surface Cleaner is a ready-to-use spray that lifts grease, fingerprints and everyday grime from kitchen counters, tables, appliances and tiles. Keep one in the kitchen and one in the bathroom.
benefits: Refill the spray from the 2.5L or 5L
ingredients: [PLACEHOLDER] Add the ingredient list exactly as printed on your label.
howToUse: Spray onto the surface from about 20cm.
Wipe with a clean, damp cloth.
For greasy areas, leave for 1 minute before wiping.

dilution.ratio: Ready to use — no dilution needed

safety: Keep out of reach of children. Do not spray near eyes or face. Do not mix with other cleaning products. Test on a small hidden area of delicate surfaces first.

faqs.q: Can I refill my spray bottle?
faqs.a: Yes. Buy the 2.5L or 5L refill and top up your trigger spray bottle.
